description: The iconic Breitling Navitimer pilot's chronograph. Developed in 1952 with a circular slide rule for in-flight calculations, it became the official timepiece of the Aircraft Owners and Pilots Association (AOPA). With its timeless design and modern touches, it remains a favorite among pilots and trendsetters. Features include a flattened slide rule, domed glass, polished and brushed metal elements, and new dial color options in blue, green, and copper. The classic AOPA wings return at the 12 o'clock position. A true symbol of Breitling's legacy and one of the most recognizable watches of all time.
introduction: The iconic Breitling Navitimer pilot's chronograph.
